proof_body:
by
  intro A h m c a R hh ha
  have hR : 0 < R := Metric.pos_of_mem_ball ha
  have hne : ∀ z ∈ Metric.sphere c R, z - a ≠ 0 := by
    intro z hz h
    have : z = a := sub_eq_zero.mp h
    subst this
    have h1 := mem_ball_iff_norm.mp ha
    have h2 := mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp hz
    linarith
  have hk : ∀ k : ℕ, ContinuousOn (fun z => A k / (z - a) ^ (k + 1)) (Metric.sphere c R) := fun k =>
    ContinuousOn.div continuousOn_const (by fun_prop) (fun z hz => pow_ne_zero _ (hne z hz))
  have hcont : ContinuousOn h (Metric.sphere c R) := hh.continuousOn.mono (by rw [closure_ball c hR.ne']; exact Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall)
  have i1 : CircleIntegrable (fun z => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), A k / (z - a) ^ (k + 1)) c R :=
    ContinuousOn.circleIntegrable hR.le (continuousOn_finset_sum _ (fun k _ => hk k))
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_add i1 (hcont.circleIntegrable hR.le), hh.circleIntegral_eq_zero hR.le, add_zero]
  rw [circleIntegral.integral_fun_sum (fun k _ => (hk k).circleIntegrable hR.le), Finset.sum_range_succ']
  have h0 : ∀ k ∈ Finset.range m, (∮ z in C(c, R), A (k + 1) / (z - a) ^ (k + 1 + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro k _
    have e : (fun z => A (k + 1) / (z - a) ^ (k + 1 + 1)) = fun z => A (k + 1) * (z - a) ^ (-(k : ℤ) - 2) := by
      funext z
      have : (-(k : ℤ) - 2) = -((k + 2 : ℕ) : ℤ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [this, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, div_eq_mul_inv]
    rw [e, circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, circleIntegral.integral_sub_zpow_of_ne (by omega), mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero h0, zero_add]
  have e : (fun z => A 0 / (z - a) ^ (0 + 1)) = fun z => A 0 * (z - a)⁻¹ := by
    funext z; simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [e, circleIntegral.integral_const_mul, circleIntegral.integral_sub_inv_of_mem_ball ha]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (A : ℕ → ℂ) (h : ℂ → ℂ) (m : ℕ) (c a : ℂ) (R : ℝ), DiffContOnCl ℂ h (Metric.ball c R) → a ∈ Metric.ball c R → (∮ z in C(c, R), ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), A k / (z - a) ^ (k + 1)) + h z)) = 2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * A 0
